title: Two Heads are Better Than One: Test-time Scaling of Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2504.09772v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Test-Time Scaling has emerged as a powerful method to extend the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models. However, single-agent TTS faces significant scalability bottlenecks, as excessively long reasoning traces lead to increased inference costs and stability issues caused by context management failures. To address these limitations, we propose leveraging Multi-Agent Systems as a structural upgrade to standard TTS. By decomposing monolithic reasoning chains into distinct, manageable contexts across multiple agents, MAS offers a more robust framework for scaling reasoning. We validate this approach by introducing M500, a dataset comprising 500 high-quality multi-agent, multi-turn collaborative reasoning traces generated via DeepSeek-R1. translated_title: 两个头脑胜过一个：多智能体协作推理的测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展已成为扩展大型语言模型推理能力的强大方法。然而，单智能体TTS面临显著的扩展瓶颈，因为过长的推理轨迹会导致推理成本增加，以及由上下文管理失败引起的稳定性问题。为解决这些限制，我们提出利用多智能体系统作为标准TTS的结构性升级。通过将整体推理链分解为多个智能体上的不同、可管理的上下文，MAS为扩展推理提供了更稳健的框架。我们通过引入M500数据集来验证这种方法，该数据集包含500条高质量的多智能体、多轮协作推理轨迹，这些轨迹通过DeepSeek-R1生成。通过在M500上进行监督微调，我们使开源模型能够内化协作推理模式，并在MAS中展现出改进的TTS性能。此外，我们提出了一种自适应策略。
tldr: 本文提出利用多智能体系统作为测试时扩展的结构性升级，通过分解推理链为多智能体上下文，并基于M500数据集进行监督微调，以提高推理性能和可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes leveraging multi-agent systems as a structural upgrade for test-time scaling, decomposing reasoning chains into multi-agent contexts and fine-tuning on the M500 dataset to improve reasoning performance and scalability.
